data.name: Legend of Ertugrul
data.detailed_description:
UNLEASH THE WARRIOR LEADER WITHIN

Use your leadership, strength, and combat-platforming skills to perform deadly combos. Defeat ruthless Mongol invaders, protect your people, and fight for justice.

FIGHT FOR HONOR AND SURVIVAL

Sharpen your swordsmanship and assassination skills. Execute deadly combos, take down enemy patrols, and defend your tribe against invading forces. Every strike, every mission, and every choice defines your destiny.

QUESTS, TRADE, AND RESOURCE MANAGEMENT

Complete quests, gather resources, and trade to strengthen your lands. Face ambushes, betrayal, and unexpected dangers. Every decision you make shapes the future of your people.

BUILD AND LEAD YOUR TRIBE

Transform a small tribe into a powerful beylic. Equip your warriors and manage your resources. Upgrade your weapons and fortify your defenses to withstand Mongol raids.

BEGIN A JOURNEY THROUGH HISTORY

Blending historical authenticity with rich storytelling, Legend of Ertuğrul invites you on a journey of honor, sacrifice, and faith. Witness the birth of a legend that will echo through the ages.

data.short_description: Legend of Ertugrul is a story-driven side-scrolling action RPG inspired by the courage and faith of Turkish warriors who shaped the early Ottoman era. You play as Ertugrul, a brave leader who must protect his tribe, forge alliances, and fight for justice across the lands of Anatolia.
